TC-09/S23.title: axe on All Residents with toggles, Today's Visits, the scan sheet, the duplicate sheet, Add Resident and the dashboard
TC-09/S23.detail: Our own accessibility check (record only; findings are suggestions A1-A4, Quinn 2026-10-14). axe-core wcag2a + wcag2aa; the scan answered in the browser (ai/vision:scanCensusSheet scripted with one new resident and one already on the panel), so the 'Possible duplicate residents' dialog was reached and checked; the scan-created resident was deleted after. Found (no surface is clean): unnamed icon buttons on the Nursing Home header and the scan sheet's close X (button-name, critical; known A1); the In Today toggle sits inside the card's role=button (nested-interactive; known A3); the toggles are named only '+ Today' / 'In Today ✓' (no resident name) and expose no pressed / checked state (known A2); contrast 2.5-3.7:1 on grey helper text, the 'Nursing Home' switch, 'Decide later' and the dashboard row line (known A4), plus the new dashboard tab label 4.34:1. Noted in passing: the scan sheet still says 'replaces today's visits' (TFA-92587 AC 3 wording, not this package's).
